# Extra apt packages the ubuntu CI runner installs before configuring the build.
# One package per line; '#' comments allowed. Read by .github/workflows/ci.yml.
# Qt 6 Widgets (ADR-0001) + the GL headers its widgets module links against.
qt6-base-dev
libgl1-mesa-dev
libzip-dev
# libzip-tools: Ubuntu splits the libzip CLI (zipcmp/zipmerge/ziptool) out of
# libzip-dev, but libzip's installed CMake targets file asserts /usr/bin/zipcmp
# exists — so find_package(libzip) errors without it. Not used at runtime.
libzip-tools
libpugixml-dev
